title: 2 Rooks VS 2 Pawns
reviewNotes: Four branches, 35 exact positions. Complete six-piece Black root and separately reconstructed late six-piece promotion node. The opening checks gain a king tempo; intermediate repeated king walk remains source context. ...Rd8 h7 draws, ...Rh1 loses. Late queen promotion is mated; knight promotion requires the checked rook sacrifice and blockade.
